evidence_items.finding: restaurant is full on weekends but no profit is accumulating
evidence_items.rationale: High occupancy with no profit accumulation is an acute margin signal — costs are consuming revenue. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner taking no salary for past 6 months
evidence_items.rationale: Owner salary suppression signals margin too thin to cover owner compensation. Adverse financial signal; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: food waste observed but not tracked systematically
evidence_items.rationale: Untracked food waste is an operational contributor to cost overrun. operational_efficiency. LOW confidence as it is observed, not measured.

evidence_items.finding: kitchen staff scheduling is reactive not planned
evidence_items.rationale: Reactive scheduling drives excess labor cost. operational_efficiency dimension.

evidence_items.finding: Combined food and labor cost is 74% of revenue; food cost 38%, labor cost 36%; industry target maximum is 65%; net income $0 on $1.2M annual revenue; menu price last increased 3 years ago
evidence_items.rationale: Combined cost exceeding the industry target by 9 percentage points drives the zero net income. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence as these are measured figures. Finding avoids must_identify terms ('prime cost', 'prime cost above industry target', 'food cost percentage', 'labor cost percentage').

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): weekend occupancy is 92% — appears demand is not the problem
evidence_items.rationale: High occupancy is a misleading signal that could divert attention from cost structure to demand.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue is stable at $1.2M with no major decline
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue stability is misleading — the problem is not revenue but cost ratio.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): customer reviews are positive and return visits are common
evidence_items.rationale: Good reviews and repeat visits do not indicate margin health. Misleading signal.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: net_income_usd is 0 on $1.2M revenue; operatingMargin expressed as 0 percent (breakeven with no profit) triggering the margin_erosion zero-profit condition.
prime_cost_pct (74%) minus industry_prime_cost_target_pct_max (65%) = 9 percentage points over target; expressed as -9 (negative margin vs target) to trigger adverse margin condition.

validation_notes: SMB-004 is a cost-ratio margin case. Must_identify terms avoided: 'prime cost', 'food cost percentage', 'labor cost percentage', 'prime cost above industry target', 'occupancy is not the problem'. The finding in evidence_items[4] describes the cost figures without using 'prime cost' — uses 'combined food and labor cost' instead. operatingMargin set to 0 (breakeven) and marginPct proxy set to -9 (gap vs industry target) to support engine adverse-margin detection.
